statement: Once the authoritative application-write formation owner declares the required cohort ready, the first application mutation admitted under that same authoritative generation is not rejected because of an older or contradictory replica-operation or placement condition. If that authority changes before admission, the mutation is either valid under still-current authority or receives a typed pre-effect refusal that requires re-entry through the same readiness owner; no possibly-applied mutation is blindly retried.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, obtain a fresh independent verifier on the exact candidate before audit and landing, then record an approving Solver verification with evidence subagent:<id>.

Before changing production source, capture one controlled formation-release to first-write-admission trace and an owner-difference table naming every admission predicate, source of truth, owner, and generation.

Formation readiness and first-write admission must use one authoritative semantic owner and a coherent generation or existing authority identity; do not duplicate predicates across modules or invent a token namespace while an existing identity suffices.

The reproducer and repair submit each application mutation exactly once. Observation may repeat, but no test-only readiness condition, generic retry, sleep, timeout expansion, or second CREATE is permitted.

If authoritative state changes after readiness, admission either remains valid under current authority or refuses before possible application with a typed result directing the caller back through the canonical readiness owner.

After the first mechanism is traced and before implementation, merge independent authority/state and interleaving challenges across publication, readiness, replica-operation, placement, leader, holder, recomputation, and pending-event dimensions.

Deterministic direct witnesses F1 through F4 are the primary proof and must include a red-on-revert treatment of the identified missing predicate or generation fence; transaction-active-owns-connection is only end-to-end confirmation.
